description.html: This 60x45x50 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 135 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

With a floor area of 60x45 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh-covered ventilation openings provide constant air circulation without letting insects or small animals through.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
